:::{#def-logically-equivalent}
#### Logically equivalent

Two [propositions](#def-proposition) $A$ and $B$,
each built from some or all of the propositions $P_1, \ldots, P_n$
with [logical connectives](#def-logical-connective),
are **logically equivalent**
[@wikipedia_logical_equivalence],
written $A \equiv B$,
when they have the same truth value <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
in every row of a [truth table](#def-truth-table) on $P_1, \ldots, P_n$.

:::
